exercises.name: Jump Rope or March in Place
exercises.notes: Easy pulse raiser. Stay relaxed and breathe through the nose when possible.

exercises.name: World’s Greatest Stretch
exercises.notes: Move smoothly through hips and T-spine. Do not force range.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.notes: Pause 1 second at the top. Keep ribs down.

exercises.name: Scapular Push-Up
exercises.notes: Keep elbows straight and move only through the shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Pogo Jumps
exercises.notes: Quick contacts, stiff ankles, stay tall.

exercises.name: Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Explode forward and stick the landing softly.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 2 reps in reserve. Hands under shoulders, full-body tension.

exercises.name: Split Squat
exercises.notes: Control the descent for 2 seconds. Front foot flat.

exercises.name: Table Row or Doorframe Row
exercises.notes: Use a sturdy setup only. Pull chest toward hands and squeeze shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Reach long with the back leg. Keep hips square.

exercises.name: Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.notes: Use a low support. Keep torso slightly forward and move under control.

exercises.name: Strict Lying Leg Raise
exercises.notes: Lower slowly and keep lower back pressed down.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Straight line from head to heel. Do not let hips sag.

exercises.name: Front Neck Isometric
exercises.notes: Press forehead gently into hands. Keep effort moderate and pain-free.

exercises.name: Back Neck Isometric
exercises.notes: Press head gently into hands. Keep neck long and controlled.

exercises.name: Shadow Boxing Tempo Intervals
exercises.notes: Work at moderate pace. Stay light on the feet and keep technique crisp.
